reels.title: Five Exiles and 17 Years of Banishment for the Faith
reels.hook: Exiled five times, yet he did not yield
reels.why: Concrete numbers (5 exiles, 17 years, half a century at the head of the Church) provide a clear story with a point. Ends with a relevant sentence about politics and faith.
reels.speaker: Mladen Parlov
reels.quote: It is not good when politics interferes in matters of faith, but that is how it was then, that is unfortunately how it is to this very day.

reels.title: Athanasius Against the World: Faith Worth Every Sacrifice
reels.hook: Is any truth worth dying for?
reels.why: A strong, well-rounded message with the memorable saying "Athanasius against the world". Ends with the nuance that it was not about hatred but about faithfulness to the truth.
reels.speaker: Mladen Parlov
reels.quote: faith is such a great treasure that it is worth every sacrifice, even the sacrifice of life.

reels.title: If Christ Is Not God, We Are Not Saved: Athanasius's Argument
reels.hook: God became man to make us gods?
reels.why: A clear and provocative logical argument ("if the logos is not God, we are not saved") and the unexpected concept of deification. An insight that is remembered.

reels.title: When More Than Half the Bishops Accepted False Teaching
reels.hook: More than half the bishops on the wrong side
reels.why: The surprising figure (over 50% of episcopal sees) and the parallel with the "dominant culture" make history relevant. The thought rounds off with the defense of the integral faith.

reels.quote: However, the orthodox bishops were convinced, as they should have been, that this was actually a betrayal of the biblical faith

reels.title: What Did Arius Actually Teach?
reels.hook: Christ: true God or merely an intermediary?
reels.why: Begins with the question "what did he want?" and in a minute clearly explains one of the greatest heresies. Well-rounded educational content.

reels.quote: because God can only be one and that is God the Father.

reels.title: „Everyone Has Their Own Truth”? The Christian Answer
reels.hook: „Everyone has their own truth.” Is that so?
reels.why: Directly confronts relativism, including statements by contemporary bishops, which encourages debate. The climax is a clear assertion that truth has a name. Cut after the sentence about the "only way" in cue 66.
reels.speaker: Mladen Parlov
reels.quote: for us Christians truth has a name, it is Jesus Christ and it has been given to us.

reels.hook: A small book with an enormous impact

reels.quote: the desert becomes a battlefield where one must prove oneself as a soldier of Christ.
